home.title: Share private GitHub repositories | share.git
home.description: Share private GitHub repositories with short, read-only links. No personal access tokens or viewer accounts. Open source and self-hostable.

ui.heading: Share a private GitHub repository
ui.intro: Create a read-only link to your repository. Recipients can browse files, branches, and commits without a GitHub account. Sign in with the GitHub App to create a link.
ui.staysPrivate: Your repo stays private on GitHub
ui.accessWarning: Anyone with this link can read all branches and history. To stop access, remove the repository from the GitHub App installation. Downloaded content cannot be recalled.
ui.help: You must administer this repository. Install the GitHub App on the repositories you want to share, then sign in to create a link.
ui.noPat: No personal access tokens collected or stored.
ui.browseThis: Browse this repository if it's public
ui.invalidRepository: Enter a GitHub repository URL or owner/repo
ui.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the link below
ui.readOnlyDescription: Give someone read-only access to files, branches, and commit history. Your share link never grants permission to change the repository.
ui.appDescription: Sign in with a GitHub App scoped to your selected repositories. share.git never asks you to paste or store a personal access token.
ui.expiryDescription: Links expire after seven days. Recipients can open the code in their browser without creating an account or joining your repository.
ui.stepOneDescription: Paste a GitHub URL or use the owner/repo shortcut. Install the GitHub App on the repository you want to share.
ui.stepTwo: Sign in and create a link
ui.stepTwoDescription: Sign in as a repository admin. share.git checks your access and creates a short, read-only link that expires in seven days.
ui.stepThreeDescription: Copy the link into a message, review request, or project handoff. They open it and browse the code. No GitHub account required.
ui.shortcutDescription: Replace github.com with {domain} in an owner/repository URL. We'll open the sharing form with that repository filled in.
ui.shortcutWarning: A shortcut prepares the form. Only an authorized admin can create a private share link.
ui.shortcutNote: Opening this shortcut does not create a share.
ui.reviewsDescription: Ask a trusted developer to explore an implementation without adding them as a repository collaborator.
ui.handoffsDescription: Give a client or teammate a browser view of the project while they review the code and documentation.
ui.learningDescription: Share a practice project with a mentor or study partner. Browse the files and talk through the decisions.
ui.trustWarning: Share only with people you trust. A link opens the entire repository, including its branches and history.
ui.openSourceDescription: MIT licensed. Inspect the code, adapt it, and run share.git with your own domain and GitHub App. You control the deployment and its credentials.
